stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post Worst Day Since June After Clarity Act Vote Fails
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded their worst trading day since June, coinciding with a failed vote on the Clarity Act. The setback in Congress appears to have hit sentiment around ETF-linked bitcoin exposure.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a key gauge of institutional demand, and a sharp reversal tied to failed crypto legislation shows how sensitive that demand is to regulatory clarity.
whatToWatch: Next spot ETF flow data
Whether lawmakers reschedule a Clarity Act vote
questions: Was the move driven by actual redemptions or just price weakness?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs Had Their Worst Day Since June Following Failed Clarity Act Vote

stories.title: Deutsche Bank Awaits Regulatory Approval for Crypto Custody Launch
stories.summary: Deutsche Bank is waiting on regulatory sign-off before launching institutional crypto custody services. The move would add a major European bank to the group of traditional lenders offering direct digital-asset custody.
stories.whyItMatters: Bank-grade custody from a systemically important lender is a concrete step toward mainstream institutional adoption of crypto assets.
whatToWatch: Timing of the regulatory approval
Which assets the custody service supports at launch
questions: Which regulator's approval is pending, and on what timeline?

sources.title: Deutsche Bank awaits regulatory nod to launch institutional crypto custody solutions

stories.title: Anchorage Digital Adds Etherlink and Tokenized Uranium to Custody Lineup
stories.summary: Anchorage Digital has expanded its institutional custody offering to include the Etherlink network and tokenized uranium. The addition broadens the range of assets the bank-chartered custodian can hold for institutional clients.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows custody providers pushing beyond mainstream tokens into niche and real-world-asset tokenization, a sign institutional interest is broadening.
whatToWatch: Institutional client uptake of the new asset types
Further asset additions from Anchorage or rival custodians
questions: How much real investor demand exists for tokenized uranium?

sources.title: Anchorage expands institutional custody to Etherlink, tokenized uranium

stories.title: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet With USDC as Native Gas Token
stories.summary: Circle has launched the mainnet for Arc, a blockchain network that uses USDC as its native gas token instead of a separate crypto asset. The launch marks Circle's expansion from stablecoin issuer into blockchain infrastructure.
stories.whyItMatters: A dollar-pegged gas token could make transaction costs more predictable for businesses, a step toward broader enterprise use of blockchains.
whatToWatch: Early transaction volume and developer adoption on Arc
How Arc competes with other stablecoin-focused chains
questions: Which applications or partners will build on Arc first?

sources.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet with USDC as native gas token

stories.title: Tonkeeper Rebrands to Keeper, Adds Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron Support
stories.summary: Tonkeeper, a wallet originally built for the TON network, has rebranded as Keeper and added support for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron. The change turns a single-chain wallet into a multi-chain product.
stories.whyItMatters: Wallet consolidation across chains lowers friction for everyday users who hold assets on multiple networks.
whatToWatch: User migration to the rebranded multi-chain wallet
Feature parity across the newly supported chains

sources.title: Tonkeeper Becomes Keeper as Wallet Adds Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron

stories.title: UK Eases Rules for Stablecoin Payments While Tightening Crypto Lending
stories.summary: The UK has introduced a rule change that opens a significant exemption for stablecoin payments, even as it tightens restrictions on crypto lending. The split approach treats payment-focused stablecoin use differently from yield-generating lending.
stories.whyItMatters: The UK's split approach could become a template for separating payments-focused crypto from investment-style crypto in regulation, shaping where firms choose to operate.
whatToWatch: Formal publication of the rules and effective dates
Industry reaction from stablecoin issuers and lending platforms
questions: How exactly is the stablecoin payments exemption scoped, and who benefits most?

sources.title: UK opens a major loophole for stablecoin payments while clamping down on crypto lending

stories.title: Bitcoin's Coinbase Premium Falls to Monthly Low on Clarity Act Vote
stories.summary: The Coinbase Premium, a measure of relative buying pressure from US investors, has dropped to its lowest level in a month. The decline is being linked to the failed Clarity Act vote weighing on US demand for bitcoin.
stories.whyItMatters: A falling Coinbase Premium suggests US buyers are pulling back, an indicator often watched ahead of broader bitcoin price moves.
whatToWatch: Whether the premium recovers as the Clarity Act situation develops

sources.title: Bitcoin Coinbase Premium hits monthly low as CLARITY Act vote squeezes US demand

stories.title: Bernstein: SEC and CFTC Likely to Pursue Aggressive Rulemaking After Clarity Act Failure
stories.summary: Analysts at Bernstein expect the SEC and CFTC to move toward more aggressive rulemaking now that the Clarity Act has failed in Congress. The forecast suggests regulators may act on their own where legislation stalled.
stories.whyItMatters: If regulators fill the gap left by failed legislation, crypto firms could face faster but less predictable compliance rules.
whatToWatch: Any SEC or CFTC rulemaking proposals in coming weeks
Further legislative attempts on crypto market structure
questions: Which rules would each agency prioritize first?

sources.title: Bernstein expects ‘aggressive’ rulemaking from SEC, CFTC, following CLARITY Act failure

stories.title: DeFi Development Opens $300M CHAD Offering With 13% Dividend
stories.summary: DeFi Development Corp, a company holding a large Solana treasury, has opened a $300 million offering under the ticker CHAD structured with a 13% dividend. The offering targets investors seeking yield tied to the firm's Solana holdings.
stories.whyItMatters: It's another example of publicly traded firms using crypto treasury strategies and structured, high-yield offerings to raise capital, a trend worth watching for signs of overextension.
whatToWatch: Investor uptake of the offering
How the 13% dividend is funded
questions: Is the dividend sustainable if Solana's price falls?

sources.title: Solana treasury giant DeFi Development opens $300M CHAD offering backed by a massive 13% dividend catch

stories.title: Ethiopia Cuts Bitcoin Miners' Power Supply by 77% Amid Hydropower Shortage
stories.summary: Ethiopia has reportedly cut power allocated to Bitcoin miners by 77%, citing a hydropower shortage. The country had become a notable mining hub thanks to cheap hydroelectric power.
stories.whyItMatters: Power curtailments in mining hubs can shift global hash rate distribution and highlight the energy trade-offs behind bitcoin mining's geography.
whatToWatch: Effect on global Bitcoin hash rate
Whether affected miners relocate to other countries
questions: How long is the power cut expected to last?

sources.title: Ethiopia cuts Bitcoin miners’ power by 77% amid hydropower shortage: Report

stories.title: Bitcoin Trades Below $76K Ahead of Fed Rate Decision
stories.summary: Bitcoin is trading below $76,000 as markets await the Federal Reserve's rate decision. Cited analysis suggests traders are discounting the odds of a dovish surprise from the Fed.
stories.whyItMatters: Fed policy remains a major driver of risk-asset sentiment, and muted expectations for a dovish surprise could limit near-term upside for bitcoin.
whatToWatch: The Fed's rate decision and accompanying statement
Bitcoin's price reaction afterward

sources.title: Bitcoin awaits Fed rate decision below $76K as analysis discounts ‘dovish surprise’ odds

stories.title: BIS Paper Finds Major Gap in Bitcoin Onchain Transfer Estimates
stories.summary: A paper from the Bank for International Settlements reportedly finds a significant gap in how Bitcoin onchain transfer volumes are estimated. The finding raises questions about the reliability of commonly cited onchain activity metrics.
stories.whyItMatters: If widely used onchain metrics misstate real transfer activity, it affects how analysts and regulators read Bitcoin's actual usage.
whatToWatch: Reaction from onchain analytics firms
Whether BIS or others propose revised methodology
questions: What causes the estimation gap, and how large is it?

sources.title: BIS paper finds major gap in Bitcoin onchain transfer estimates
